entries.notes: 石 five (1-5) and the long bar and 氺 of 彔 (8-13) match. The dictionary writes the first stroke of 彑 as a vertical that turns right at the bottom (6) and the second as a bar that turns down at the right (7); the pinned MM candidate writes the first as a bar that turns down at the right and the second as a short bar. The vertical of the dictionary's first stroke cannot be derived from the candidate bar's own points, so the glyph fails closed. The inventory lists a 13-stroke Ja candidate that a later batch could pin instead
